description.zh: 管理 X、LinkedIn、Facebook、Instagram、Threads、YouTube、小红书、抖音、B 站和知乎账号。Facebook 公共主页、Instagram 专业账号和 Threads 支持官方 API 连接、发布和采集；Instagram 支持单图和 Reel，Threads 支持文字、单图和视频。其他平台按能力发布、排期和采集。
description.en: Manage X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili and Zhihu. Connect Facebook Pages, Instagram professional accounts and Threads through official APIs for publishing and collection. Instagram supports single images and Reels; Threads supports text, single images and video. Other publishing, scheduling and collection features depend on the platform.
